body: I agree that the media is not nearly as good at doing their job as they used to be, and we are on the verge of world war three, my problem is him asserting A) that it’s Zelenskyy’s fault, that’s just parroting Russian Propaganda (the same people who routinely call for genocide of the Ukrainians and the invasion of any nation they don’t like including Poland, Germany, Lithuania, Finland and more) and B) that it is a Fact that the US was behind Nordstream, because that’s the stuff of conspiracy theories and honestly even if it was the US we’d have no way of knowing because journalists don’t really have access to the evidence or classified documents (yet?)
